what: While the section’s top edge approaches from one screen height below over 400px, its size grows along with it from .8 to 1 (chasing at .2s per progress step) — when progress is 0 it returns to 1. The original attaches .6s after the section loads and is used on desktop only

options.wait: Delay after attaching before hooking on (seconds), default .6

from.where: Section-size effect from the original bundle.js ([data-animation=section-scale], start top-=Window height · end top-=(window height−400) · .2s overwrite, only when wider than 1025px) — the seven recorded pages lack this marker, so it is not applied to the copy pages

note: ScrollTrigger start as in the original ”top-=Set as the single word ‹window height› — the screen-side reference follows the ScrollTrigger default
